title: 1.2 What people do
unit_outcome: Describe people and family, say what people do every day and how often, and ask about other people’s habits.
goal: Say what a person does with he/she and the -s ending (Luis drinks coffee.), against I drink coffee. and A1's Luis is drinking coffee.
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 1.2 People in Action: He is eating. becomes He eats fruit. The one new grammar relationship is he/she + verb + -s (A1 has it only for wants/needs), taught as the contrast I drink coffee. / Luis drinks coffee. and heard against A1's is ...-ing.
prerequisite: A1 1.2 eating, drinking, reading, writing; 1.9 Who…?; 2.9 books; 5.1 fruit; 5.3 coffee, drink; 7.7 read; A1+ 1.1 the cast.
speaking_outcome: A clear final s in drinks and eats (/s/) and in reads (/z/), and writes with a clean /ts/, inside the complete sentence. Do not require native-like speed.
